modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before undertaking daily trips/starting the shift

pcs.pc_description: inspect the vehicle as per the organization’s work instructions/health and safety guidelines before leaving for delivery of orders
clean the vehicle as per organization’s SOPs or vehicle user manual
check the food delivery box for proper placement on the vehicle, any damage, and leftover food items/crumbs/liquid
sanitize the food delivery box, delivery equipment and the vehicle as per health and hygiene standards
perform routine maintenance checks on the vehicle like fuel level, working condition of horn, head lights and tyre pressure
confirm availability and validity of all the vehicle related documents as per the standards
record any anomalies or technical/compliance issues observed during an examination and cleaning the vehicle or during the previous trip
report actual or potential defects to the senior driver/supervisor in detail to determine road worthiness of the vehicle
inform superior about any requirements such as fuel refill or repair

modules.module_title: Collect order details, packages and other pre- requisites to deliver the order

pcs.pc_description: wear proper uniform and PPE like mask, gloves etc. as per organizational policy
obtain details of customers and food and beverage orders to be delivered like customer name, delivery location, invoice, mode of payment, delivery instructions, special requests, etc.
update the details on the application/software, if applicable
collect the card swipe/digital payment machine and details of digital wallet, if required
collect the ordered packages carefully from the kitchen/dispatch window
plan travel routes based on location and estimated travel time
ensure sufficient amount of change money based on the purchase amount and if not ask for same from the account’s division
count and verify all food and beverage products individually as per the bill before leaving the kitchen
ensure the package contains disposable cutlery, tissue papers, appropriate condiments etc.
ensure that food and beverages are packed properly (not open, leaking, and are sturdy in case of fragile items like glass)

modules.module_title: Load food and beverage packages on the vehicle

pcs.pc_description: organize the order packages as per delivery location and priority
store the delivery packages safely in the boot of the two-wheeler and with proper cover to prevent damage during transit
use insulated hot and cold bags to keep food at the appropriate temperature

modules.module_title: Conform to traffic rules and regulations

pcs.pc_description: adhere to local and state driving laws and road regulations
follow lane discipline and change lanes safely at appropriate speed as per traffic conditions
overtake other road users legally, safely and by using correct signalling (e.g. use of indicators while turning left/right)
control the speed limit and distance in relation to other vehicles ahead, behind and on the sides and maintain a safe distance
brake the vehicle in a manner appropriate to the driving conditions and the distance available for braking the vehicle
report any road accidents and traffic violations to the company promptly

modules.module_title: Deliver food packages and collect payment

pcs.pc_description: drive carefully to avoid damage or spillage of the food packages to be delivered
greet the customer cordially on reaching the delivery location as per the organizational standards
sanitize hands and the delivery equipment before handing over the package to the customer
deliver the packages safely by taking special care of liquid or fragile items, after reaching the destination
provide instructions to the customers regarding safe handling of the package
inform the details of the delivery items in the package
maintain no-contact delivery and place the item in a bag outside customer’s door, if required
handle the payment of the order, as required if the order is not pre-paid
record all payment information for delivered packages
update the delivery status after each delivery on the online portal
answer customers’ questions and respond to complaints in a professional manner
investigate any discrepancies with the delivered packages
ask for online/offline customer feedback on provided services
submit the day’s completely filled log sheet and delivery report of all orders
report anything specific related to day’s work e.g. road conditions, difficult customer, etc.
report any technical fault/problem faced during delivery to supervisor
note down the readings in the vehicle log book to calculate the fuel consumption and vehicle’s average mileage
park and cover the vehicle at the designated place in a safe manner as per the organization’s SOP
